recommendedTechniques.title: Box Breathing (4x4)
recommendedTechniques.description: Navy SEAL grounding pattern that synchronizes autonomic nervous tone and restores mental clarity.
steps: Inhale through nose for 4 counts.
Hold breath with soft throat for 4 counts.
Exhale gently through mouth for 4 counts.
Hold empty lungs calmly for 4 counts.
Repeat for 6 full boxes.

recommendedTechniques.title: Progressive Muscle Decompression
recommendedTechniques.description: Systematically release residual tension in jaw, shoulders, and lower lumbar region.
steps: Squeeze shoulders up to ears for 5 seconds, noticing tension.
Release abruptly and let shoulder blades melt downward on exhale.
Tense fists and forearms tightly for 5s, then release completely.
Notice the warmth and rush of blood flow entering the relaxed muscles.

recommendedTechniques.title: Cyclic Physiological Sigh
recommendedTechniques.description: The fastest neurobiological method to down-regulate autonomic heart rate and vent accumulated CO2.
steps: Take two consecutive nasal inhales: one deep inhale, followed immediately by a sharp second top-up sniff.
Release with a slow, unforced, extended audible exhale through open mouth.
Repeat smoothly for 25 to 30 cycles.

Stay passively conscious without needing to fall asleep.
